description: Dates that apply to every applicant in a cycle (specs/planner/timeline.md "The cycle file"). One object per cycle, named by the academic year in which students apply. Reviewed in a data PR each spring when the next cycle's dates are published; checked by scripts/check-cycle.mts (npm run verify). Fixed federal and national dates, the counselors' windows, SAT and ACT dates as College Board and ACT publish them (a test date without register_by is a projected date with no registration yet; dates not yet published are left out, never guessed), the AP calendar (ordering deadline, the May exams, scores out; College Board, read 2026-10-11), the usual course-request window, and the summer list (applies: committed). SAT and ACT dates read 2026-10-08.

entries.label: Ask two teachers for recommendations
entries.detail: Before summer, while they remember your work. Give them at least a month before your first deadline.

entries.label: Draft the personal essay
entries.detail: The Common App prompts rarely change from year to year, so you can start before applications open.

entries.label: Common App opens for the new season
entries.detail: Accounts roll over; the essay prompts and each college's questions are live from today.

entries.label: Write each college's supplement essays
entries.detail: Start with the colleges whose deadlines come first.

entries.label: FAFSA opens
entries.detail: File early: some state and college aid is first come, first served.

entries.label: CSS Profile opens
entries.detail: Needed only by the colleges on your list that ask for it.

entries.label: Check each college's applicant portal for missing items
entries.detail: A week or two after you apply, and then every couple of weeks until it says complete.

entries.label: Thank your recommenders
entries.detail: A short note once your applications are in, and tell them where you get in.

entries.label: National reply date
entries.detail: The deposit date at most colleges that admit in the regular round; check each college's own date.

entries.label: Ask your school to send the final transcript
entries.detail: To the college you chose only.

entries.label: Sign up for orientation
entries.detail: Sessions fill up; the college's admitted-student portal has the dates.

entries.label: Send health and immunization forms
entries.detail: The college's health center lists what it needs before move-in.

entries.label: Accept the parts of the aid offer you'll use
entries.detail: Accept grants first; take only the loans you need.

entries.label: Sign up for AP exams by your school's deadline
entries.detail: The College Board's final ordering deadline for fall and full-year AP courses is November 13, 2026; orders after it cost $40 more per exam, through March 12, 2027. Your AP coordinator's date is usually earlier.

entries.label: AP exams
entries.detail: Two weeks in May, as the College Board publishes them. Your AP coordinator sets your days and room.

entries.label: AP scores out (projected)
entries.detail: Early July: the 2026 scores reached students on July 6. The College Board hasn't published the 2027 date yet, so this window is projected.
